tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Main page background. Never pure white in light or pure black in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, answer rows, degree cards and other primary content surfaces.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Progress and score tracks, answer hover, quiet panels such as the camera frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised layers such as menus. Pair with shadow-soft.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected answer row: brand-green mixed 7% into surface. Keep it this faint.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, questions, answer text and headings on bg, surface, surface-subtle and surface-selected. 13:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and explanations on any surface. 5.4:1 or better in light, 9.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary metadata only, never instructions or answer text. Source value kept: in light it reads 3.6 to 3.9:1, below AA for small text, so use it at 18px+ or accept it as non-essential metadata.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px border on cards, answer rows and inputs. Decorative separation only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline and the selected answer row. Below 3:1 on surfaces in both themes, so never let a border alone carry a state.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Navigation, headings, structural emphasis, secondary match score bars. As text: 6.4:1+ in light; in dark only 3.6 to 4.5:1, so use it as text at 24px+ or on bg only.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Primary actions, selected markers, progress fill, the primary match score bar. Never as text in light (2.7:1); always label a green fill with on-green.

tokens.name: brand-green-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Light value is from the source; dark value is a chosen slightly brighter step.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on a brand-green fill. Replaces the source's white label, which reads only 2.7:1 (light) and 2.3:1 (dark); this pair reads 5.5:1 and 8.4:1.

tokens.name: brand-lime
tokens.usage: Small highlights and supporting accents only. Never text, never a large fill.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary visual accents and data visualization. Never text in light (2.1:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset. 6.4:1+ on every light surface, 7.9:1+ in dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors such as a failed capture or generation. Pair with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings such as camera permission needed. In light it reads 3.4 to 3.8:1, so use it for icons or text 18px+; the message itself stays in text-primary.

tokens.name: nsbm-blue
tokens.usage: Official logo sample. Fixed across themes; reference only, use brand-blue in UI.

tokens.name: nsbm-green
tokens.usage: Official logo sample. Fixed across themes; reference only, use brand-green in UI.

tokens.name: nsbm-lime
tokens.usage: Official logo sample. Fixed across themes; reference only, use brand-lime in UI.

tokens.name: nsbm-cyan
tokens.usage: Official logo sample. Fixed across themes; reference only, use brand-cyan in UI.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Main match score on the primary result. 44px on mobile.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Landing hero title, desktop. 40px on tablet, 32px on mobile.

styles.name: result-title
styles.usage: Pathway name on the primary result card. 32px on mobile.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section titles such as Available Degree Programmes. 24px on mobile.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Secondary pathway names and degree titles.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Question text in the questionnaire. 20px on mobile.
styles.sample: Which work environment sounds most appealing?

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Hero supporting copy and result explanations.
styles.sample: Answer five short questions to discover the computing pathways that best match your interests.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body, answer text, degree details.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Supporting info, progress label, privacy notes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between related lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between answer rows; inner component spacing.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default inner padding; mobile page padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding; card inner spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a title block and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing (small).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section spacing (default).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section spacing (large). Avoid giant empty sections beyond this.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks, tracks, compact controls.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Input fields and the theme toggle.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Answer rows, degree cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Result cards. The largest radius in the system; never 24px+.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: The only shadow. Primary result card and raised layers; cards never float dramatically.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Main content max width, centred, with space-6 side padding (space-4 on mobile).

tokens.name: question-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the centred question panel.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header height; up to 72px is fine.

tokens.name: logo-width
tokens.usage: Logo width on desktop.

tokens.name: logo-width-mobile
tokens.usage: Logo width on mobile.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target height. Buttons 44px, answer rows 56px.

tokens.name: answer-min
tokens.usage: Answer row minimum height.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Mobile: single column, 16px page padding.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet: single-column questionnaire, two-column result areas allowed.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: Desktop: constrained content, two-column primary result, 2-column degree grid.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Wide screens: content stays at content-max.

tokens.name: transition-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and selection on buttons and answer rows.

tokens.name: transition-normal
tokens.usage: Progress updates and page changes (keep page changes under 150ms where possible).
